in_english.name: Bethanne
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bethanne originates from Hebrew roots, combining 'בַּיִת' (beth), meaning house or home, and 'אָנִי' (anne), meaning grace or favor. It signifies a dwelling place of God or a house of grace, reflecting divine presence and blessing. Historically, the name carries spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing a place of worship, prayer, and communion with God. In modern usage, Bethanne is associated with qualities of piety, gratitude, and devotion
